title: 日本ダービーの後に・強くなれば

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her excellent running, Gold City makes her mark in the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite not taking the win, she believes she has shown her true skill, but she frowns at the comments from the audience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her running is praised, but unsurprisingly accompanied by comments about her beauty. She doubts whether she'll ever manage to change her reputation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But there is still the Kikuka Sho to look forward to, a race where only the strongest prevail. She readies herself for another attempt to change the narrative surrounding her.
